selection_reason: APM-03 completed_verified in PR #431. CSW-02 and CSW-05 satisfy CSW-06 dependencies; owner-approved interleave selects CSW-06 before APM-04.
objective: Define a continuity, consistency and open-thread tracker that helps creators find unresolved hooks/questions/secrets/payoffs, unused/dormant material, timeline/name/reference inconsistencies and contradiction candidates with traceable evidence while keeping analysis advisory, visibility-safe and incapable of silently rewriting creator or Campaign truth.
completion_gate: The app can surface actionable continuity/open-thread candidates with traceable authorized evidence and creator dispositions while never silently rewriting creator or Campaign truth, leaking hidden material or presenting inference as objective fact.
required_design_questions: What durable open-thread model covers hooks, questions, secrets, foreshadow/payoff, unresolved choices and creator-marked obligations?
How are open, needs-attention, possibly-inconsistent, unused, resolved and intentionally-unresolved states represented without implying objective correctness?
Which deterministic analyses can identify dangling references, orphaned material, timeline/date conflicts, terminology/name drift, setup/payoff gaps and unused/dormant entities?
How do CSW-05 structural warnings feed the tracker without becoming authoritative diagnoses?
How are evidence links/version/provenance attached to every candidate?
How are contradiction candidates distinguished from confirmed contradictions when source material is incomplete or pre-authoritative?
How are mystery/clue coverage checks advisory without treating hypotheses as truth?
How do dismiss/snooze/accept/resolve/intentionally-unresolved dispositions persist and avoid repeated nagging?
How are privacy/visibility filters applied before graph/search/count/similarity/AI analysis?
What role may optional AI play in comparison/critique without rewriting source text or inventing facts?
How are stale evidence/version changes detected and candidates re-evaluated?
What accessibility/mobile/nonvisual workflows support reviewing and resolving candidate queues?
preserved_parallel_tracks: APW-05 remains later in approved sequence
next_action: Execute CSW-06 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining open-thread identity/lifecycle, deterministic continuity analyses, evidence/provenance, candidate dispositions, mystery/visibility/AI boundaries, stale re-evaluation and accessible review workflows.
